question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: On the Q2 FY27 call (Aug 26, 2026) NVIDIA management said gross margin would bottom at 71%-72% in Q4 FY27 because of memory costs, then recover to 72-73% in FY28. Q3 was guided at 74.0% +/-50bp. NVIDIA's formal guide usually lands close to the prior call's commentary, so the GAAP midpoint centres on ~71.5%. GAAP may sit 0-0.2pp below non-GAAP, and memory costs could keep rising (downside); price increases kicking in sooner could lift it (upside). Human markets: Polymarket only lists Q3 actual non-GAAP GM brackets (73-75% at ~0.66, ~$1.9k volume) - a different contract, consistent with ~74% for Q3, not used as an anchor.
calls.dossier:
- NVIDIA Q2 FY27 press release (Aug 26, 2026): Q3 FY27 outlook: GAAP and non-GAAP GM 74.0% +/-50bp; revenue $108.0B +/-2%; GAAP opex ~$9.2B.
- Actual GM: Q2 FY27 GAAP 75.0%/non-GAAP 75.0%; Q1 FY27 74.9%/75.0%; Q2 FY26 72.4%/72.5%; Q4 FY26 75.0%/75.2%; full FY26 GAAP 71.1%/non-GAAP 71.3% (NVIDIA releases).
- Q2 FY27 earnings call (Aug 26, 2026; reported by TIKR, CNBC, BigGo, search snippets): management expects GM to 'bottom at 71% to 72% in the fourth quarter' (Q4 FY27) because memory prices rose more than expected and are 'headed even higher into next year'; expects 72-73% in FY28 as price increases take effect. Sources do not say whether this is GAAP or non-GAAP.
- Earlier commentary (FY26 end): aim to hold GM 'in the mid-70s' through FY27 - later revised down.
- GAAP vs non-GAAP GM guidance gap has been 0.0pp (Q3 FY27 guide) to ~0.2pp (past guides).
- Oct 16, 2026 news: stock fell ~5.75% on AI-funding worries; $279B supply commitments; Vera Rubin ramp, supply tight through FY28.
- Status quo: the formal guide matches the prior call's 71-72% bottoming commentary.
- Resolves off the Q3 FY27 press release 'Outlook' GAAP GM midpoint (expected ~Nov 18-19, 2026), rounded to 0.1%; not the call commentary and not non-GAAP.
- Event window: single event, the Q3 FY27 release; as of Oct 17, 2026 the release has not happened.
- Polymarket lists only Q3 actual non-GAAP GM brackets (thin volume); no market for the Q4 guide was found.
- Searched for but could not find: any intra-quarter update on Q4 GM from NVIDIA after August; whether the 71-72% figure is GAAP or non-GAAP.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same facts: the 71-72% Q4 bottom stated on the Aug 26 call, the Q3 guide of 74.0% +/-50bp, no intra-quarter update found, and no matching market. The only open fact is whether 71-72% was a GAAP or non-GAAP figure. The dossiers can't settle it, but recent GAAP/non-GAAP equality limits it to roughly 0-0.2pp, which I carried as slight downside spread. The rest is judgment about the width of the spread. I carried forward Run 1's distribution because the evidence supports a 71.5 center with about 1.4pp of 10-90 width. I priced no mass outside the range for lack of a concrete mechanism.
